end.summary:
Identified plant-eaters, meat-eaters, and animals that eat both.
Built and read food chains using arrows in five attempts.
Explained how teeth relate to the food animals eat.
Discussed effects of changes in food chains, including fewer snakes and pollinators.
Arrow direction was mixed up once, then corrected in the next chain.
end.parentNote: Manav practised grouping animals by what they eat and making food chains with arrows. They used reasons about teeth and explained how changes in one part of a food chain can affect other animals, crops, and fruits. The arrow direction was briefly mixed up but was corrected later by reading the chain aloud. At home, ask them to make one food chain and explain what each arrow means.
